integrity: The mathematical proof covers every m,n>=2 and every set of distinctly individualized vertices including the empty set. The two standalone finite checks are corroborative; no external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Within-graph orbit recovery only; no graph-identification theorem among arbitrary graphs.
No extension to Hamming products of three or more complete-graph factors, arbitrary bipartite line graphs, or unindividualized color patterns.
Priority against all specialist literature has not been independently established.
title: Uniform two-round orbit recovery under arbitrary landmarks in rook graphs
